# Matos Distribution

> Matos Distribution LLC places smart, cashless vending machines in bars, nightclubs and nightlife venues across Puerto Rico. Fully managed and revenue-share: the venue pays nothing and earns a monthly share of sales.

## What we do
- Install, stock, service and insure the machine; the venue only provides a spot and a standard outlet.
- Cashless payments (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, ATH Móvil); remote monitoring 24/7; QR code on every machine for guest feedback.
- Built-in ID reader verifies age before dispensing any 21+ product (vapes, nicotine pouches), so restricted items can be sold legally even in 18+ venues.
- Products: disposable vapes, nicotine pouches, lighters, charging cables, condoms, personal care, rolling papers (venue's choice), Pokémon cards and mystery packs, night-out extras.
- Machine models: Mega Wall 2.0, Slim Wall, Mini Wall, Slim Tower, Weather Wall. The most compact needs about two square feet.
- Terms: no cost, no deposit, no fees; 30- and 60-day pilots available; cancellation with 15 days' notice.

## Service area
Puerto Rico: metro San Juan first (San Juan, Santurce, Condado, Guaynabo, Carolina, Bayamón, Caguas) and island-wide.
